lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Two collaborator vehicles are fleeing the exclusion zone. Intercept and hold.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Cleanup lance is approaching from the north with weapons hot.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: We reach the convoy first. Nobody fires until I know who is inside.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: They told us the government was coming to evacuate witnesses.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: The cleanup lance targeted them before it targeted us.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: We have the weapons locks, depot manifests, and the edited target packet.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then this ends at Aldric’s desk. Through official channels, with every record.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: The convoy is gone. Command will call it an accident unless we stop them.

midBattle.speaker: government
midBattle.text: Vale, detain the collaborator convoy. Cleanup units are authorized to assist.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: I have passenger heat signatures. These are witnesses, not combatants.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Heavy cleanup frame has weapons lock on the transports—not on us.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Government lance, stand down. Those transports are under my protection.

followUpLines.speaker: nyx
followUpLines.text: No response. Their order is extermination.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Transport armor is failing. Get between them and the cleanup line!
